verdict: Leads held steady this period, but cost per lead rose sharply last week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $9.14, with all paid activity running through a single campaign. In the most recent 7 days, spend rose 66% while lead volume stayed flat, pushing cost per lead up by the same margin — a signal that the current campaign is losing efficiency at its scaled budget. Early this week (Oct 13–15), lead volume also ran roughly 46% below the three days prior at a similar daily spend, so the trend is being addressed now by reviewing budget allocation and campaign structure. Separately, your Google Business Profile showed a 95% drop in tracked engagement week-over-week, which is being investigated as a likely tracking issue rather than an actual drop in visibility. Once both the lead cost and the profile tracking are corrected, you should see more accurate performance data and a healthier cost per lead entering the next period.
